title: News language data and AI reading cards
question: Can existing published bilingual commentary be presented without invented data?
hypotheses: Published commentary can be selected by scope and locale without model requests.
acceptance_criteria: AI cards select market or ticker commentary and hide absent data.
Locale-aware news fields prefer supplied translations.
Both markets retain responsive filters and safe text rendering.
evidence: Owner requests Chinese titles and existing AI cards; current published US headlines lack translations.
